Corollary
[trace Li–Yau–Hamilton estimate] Source: cao-zhu 1. Corollary 2.5.5\group Cao–Zhu Li-Yau-Hamilton Estimates For any one-form $V_a$ we have \[ \frac{\partial R}{\partial t}+\frac{R}{t} +2\nabla _aR\cdot V_a+2R_{ab}V_aV_b\geq 0. \]
